objective: Validate two independent physical decks and the realtime mixer on the real Windows browser/audio device. Do not evaluate musical SYNC in this phase.
scope: Deck A + Deck B + mixer physical/runtime validation only.
No SYNC expectation: the two tracks are allowed to be musically unrelated and unsynchronized.
Do not patch product/system code from validation/local-debug.
Do not build the musical-clock or SYNC modules.
steps: Check out the exact requested SHA and run python bootstrap.py; require LIBERTAS BOOT: PASS.
Run npm install and npm run check.
Start Vite and open the app in headed Edge/Chrome on the normal physical Windows audio output.

Load an ordinary local audio file into Deck A and a second ordinary local audio file into Deck B when available; generated sources may supplement but not replace the two-file test if two files are available.
Start both decks simultaneously and confirm both are audible through the mixer with no crackle, dropout, obvious corruption, or state mismatch.
Pause Deck A while Deck B continues. Confirm Deck B transport and audio continue unchanged. Resume A.
Pause Deck B while Deck A continues. Confirm Deck A transport and audio continue unchanged. Resume B.
Seek Deck A several times while Deck B continues; then seek Deck B while Deck A continues. Confirm the untouched deck does not jump, pause, reset, or change rate.
Exercise Deck A volume 1->0->1 while Deck B remains audible and advancing. Repeat for Deck B while Deck A remains audible and advancing.
Mute/unmute A independently, then B independently. Confirm muted deck transport continues advancing and the other deck is unaffected.
Test independent varispeed on each deck at 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x, and 2x while the other deck remains running.
Sweep master volume 1->0.25->0->1. Confirm it affects the mixed output without altering either deck transport.
Perform at least 40 mixed operations across both decks: play, pause, seek, rate, volume, mute/unmute, and master-volume changes.
Capture A/B/mixer status, run the provided 600 ms main-thread block, capture status again, and compute source/output frame deltas and new discontinuities for all three realtime processors.
Run both decks simultaneously for at least 5 minutes. Record audible dropouts/clicks, state stalls, console/runtime errors, and discontinuity deltas.
Refresh mixer status and record inputAPeak, inputBPeak, summedPeakBeforeClamp, outputPeak, clippedSamples, and masterVolume.
Write reports/local-debug/LATEST.json, ENVIRONMENT.json, SESSION_LOG.md, and small evidence artifacts if useful on validation/local-debug, then push.
evidence_required: Windows/browser/physical-output identity and AudioContext rate/latencies/render quantum.
Deck A and Deck B local file names/formats, decoder provider, channels, sample rate, frame count/duration.
Audible confirmation that simultaneous two-deck playback is clean.
Independent Deck A/B volume and mute results.
600 ms stress: A source delta, B source delta, mixer output delta, and new discontinuities for A/B/mixer.
Five-minute simultaneous-run results and final discontinuities.
Mixer telemetry and browser console/runtime errors.
stop_conditions: Stop BLOCKED if exact SHA checkout or bootstrap fails.
Stop FAIL if either deck cannot decode/play or the mixer cannot produce physical output.
Do not mark failure merely because the tracks are not beat-synchronized; SYNC is not part of Phase 4.
Do not modify product/system code from validation/local-debug.
